brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested three Palestinians during a raid on the Krum Ashor neighborhood in Nablus city, the Ma'an news agency reported. The detentions took place as troops entered the West Bank city in what witnesses described as a security operation targeting the residential area.

The arrests mark the latest in a series of military incursions into Palestinian population centers in the occupied West Bank. Israeli forces routinely conduct raids across the territory, citing security concerns, though Palestinian officials and rights groups say the operations amount to collective punishment and contribute to escalating tensions in the region.
title: Israeli forces arrest three Palestinians during Nablus operation
